title: Continuous Ensemble Weather Forecasting with Diffusion Models

contributions.purpose: 无需自回归迭代即可并行采样时间一致的集合预报轨迹,消除rollout误差累积与串行瓶颈
contributions.mechanism: Continuous Ensemble Forecasting:条件扩散模型以lead time为输入单步预测,通过关联(如冻结)不同lead time的driving noise来保证轨迹时间一致性,并行求解lead-time-dependent probability flow ODE
contributions.evaluation: 定量:并行化6h步后单成员10天6h分辨率预报采样从AR-6h的32s降到8s(ARCI-24/6h)
contributions.domain: 机器学习全球天气预报(MLWP)
contributions.source_quote: We propose a novel method for ensemble weather forecasting built on diffusion that: 1) can generate ensemble member trajectories without iteration

contributions.purpose: 在任意(非等间隔)lead time上预报,实现任意精细时间分辨率
contributions.mechanism: 单一模型将lead time作为条件参数输入score网络,直接从边缘分布 p(X(t)|X(Ω),t) 采样,无需固定步长δ
contributions.evaluation: 定性:同一模型可产生1小时分辨率10天预报;t2m等强时变场在每次迭代首步(1h,25h,...)因需外推而表现较差
contributions.domain: 机器学习全球天气预报(MLWP)

contributions.purpose: 结合自回归以在长rollout上提升性能并保持高分辨率精度
contributions.mechanism: ARCI:将continuous forecasting与自回归rollout组合(如ARCI-24/6h,24h自回归步内并行6h continuous步)
contributions.evaluation: Tab.1/Fig.4:ARCI-24+6h在6h分辨率上优于所有模型(含外部baseline Graph-EFM与GenCast式AR-6h),几乎所有分数上匹配AR-24h
contributions.domain: 机器学习全球天气预报(MLWP)
contributions.source_quote: 3) can be used together with iteration to improve performance on long rollouts

contributions.purpose: 证明方法在全球天气预报上达到有竞争力的性能且概率性质良好
contributions.mechanism: 在ERA5上以RMSE、CRPS、Spread/Skill-Ratio(SSR)评估,并对比Deterministic、AR-6/24h(GenCast重实现)、CI-6h、DYffusion、Graph-EFM等baseline
contributions.evaluation: z500/t850等变量5/10天预报;所有概率模型明显优于确定性模型;超越同架构重实现的GenCast与DYffusion;重训5次误差棒证明对初始化鲁棒
contributions.domain: 机器学习全球天气预报(MLWP)
contributions.source_quote: 4) achieves competitive performance in global weather forecasting.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Similarly to Price et al. (2025), we model p(X[k+1]|X[k-M:k]) using a conditional diffusion model ... We consider the SDE formulation of diffusion models presented by Karras et al. (2022)
the AR- models can thus be seen as a reimplementation of GenCast with a U-Net architecture

Nguyen et al. (2023; 2025) use a similar setup, but train a single model taking the forecast lead time as an input. This approach, called continuous forecasting ... has so far only been applied to deterministic models.

notes: 多处负结果/trade-off:(1) CI-6h(纯continuous)短期好但长horizon明显退化,因初始态与远lead time弱相关难学;(2) 所有扩散模型SSR<1,存在系统性欠离散(underdispersion);(3) ARCI-24/2h*对强时变场t2m在每次迭代首步表现更差(需外推到未训练的lead time);(4) 方法的理论shortcoming:冻结噪声使轨迹在给定时间点条件下变为conditionally deterministic(Dirac point mass),违背所建模过程的随机性假设。方法明确定位为GenCast/DYffusion同架构对比的改进。
